name: Kirai na Mono
source:
A short horror sound novel with only a single choice.

"So what is the thing that girl hates?"

[Translated from [url=http://t-o-k.sakura.ne.jp/yuugi/s/kirainamono.htm]official site[/url].]
translation:
一部简短的恐怖声音小说，只有一个选择。

“那么，那个女孩子最讨厌的事情是什么呢？”

[翻译自[url=http://t-o-k.sakura.ne.jp/yuugi/s/kirainamono.htm]官方网站[/url]。]
